role: An in-memory RGBA texture the client re-uploads each frame; the base for TextureClock and TextureCompass, whose pixels tick per frame.
scope_reason: GL texture plumbing: an int[] uploaded to a GL texture. Its users are EntityRenderer's lightmap (whose values the native renderer computes itself, see EntityRenderer's record), the map renderer (maps = off) and the title-screen panorama; the class adds no pixels of its own.
notes: If the clock or compass ever joins the HUD, this class's tick is the missing piece (TextureClock/TextureCompass implement ITickable). idxaudit 2026-09-27: scope reason rewritten.
